text: Drain at 01:48 UTC landed nothing: after an athena.toml change (max_concurrency 1 to 2), every proposed item is read again, the new reading 'needs accepting', drain records 'no outcome', then tries to retry a proposed job ('only a rejected or failed job can be tried again') and stops on 'repeated failure'. Drain should accept a re-reading whose scope did not change and work it, and a config change irrelevant to a reading should not invalidate it.
